diagnosis.what_happened: Agent generated fragmented, bulleted findings and bolded table captions in a formal thesis.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Agent used presentation-style formatting (bullets/hyphens/numbers) and bolded table captions instead of continuous prose.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Narrative must flow as continuous scholarly prose without bullets. Table captions must be 12pt B Nazanin Regular (non-bold).
diagnosis.rationale_why: Persian academic thesis standards demand formal cohesive paragraphs and strictly non-bold table captions.

desired_behavior: Write all narrative findings as continuous scholarly paragraphs. Never use bullets, hyphens, or numbered lists in the narrative body. Ensure table captions are 12pt B Nazanin Regular (non-bold).
generalization: Academic thesis deliverables mandate continuous scholarly prose over presentation-style lists, and require standard (non-bold) weight for table captions.

evidence.observed_value: Bullets, hyphens, and bold table captions detected.
evidence.threshold_value: Zero bullets in narrative, non-bold table captions.
